title: Euler characteristics of twists by several invertible modules form a numerical polynomial
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a proper scheme over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism], let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $\mathcal L_1,\ldots,\mathcal L_r$ be invertible $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-sc-invertible-module]. Then the map $(n_1,\ldots,n_r)\mapsto\chi(X,\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L_1^{\otimes n_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathcal L_r^{\otimes n_r})$ [def-pc-euler-characteristic] from $\mathbf Z^r$ to $\mathbf Z$ is a numerical polynomial in $n_1,\ldots,n_r$ of total degree at most $\dim\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension].
